The data has no labels, and I couldn't classify the pairs automatically. There is no internet access and no NLI model installed. Reading all 1772 pairs by hand wasn't practical.

I assumed the three labels are roughly balanced, so 1772 / 3 ≈ 591. That is a guess about how the dataset is split, not a measured result.
